ModMetaData.name: Maximum Animal Density 最大动物密度
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
If there are too many animals generated in the tiles, the game could be really laggy for old computers. This mod will limit the maximum number of animals generated in the tiles. Please go to mod settings to set the uniform upper limit.
如果地图上生成的动物数量过多，游戏可能会在老旧电脑上变得非常卡顿。 本模组将限制地图上生成的动物数量上限。 请前往模组设置界面设置统一的上限。
